name: io.github.googlarz/proton-mail-bridge-client
description: Safety-first CLI and Claude Desktop MCP server for Proton Mail via Proton Bridge. Start read-only or drafts-only, require your approval before anything is sent or deleted, keep a tamper-evident audit log. Everything runs locally over Bridge's IMAP/SMTP; no third-party relay ever touches your mail.

environmentVariables.name: PROTONMAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Proton Bridge password (Bridge app -> account -> Mailbox details) — not your Proton account password
